title: SCP: Containment Breach - The Movie
overview: The first 10 minutes of a full-length SCP - Containment Breach movie is here! With live-action appearances of iconic anomalies like SCP-173, SCP-079, SCP-963, and more. Inspired by the SCP: CB video game and based on the SCP Foundation wiki, this proof-of-concept short film follows a routine day inside Site-19 that shatters when multiple anomalies break loose, plunging the facility into chaos. This short introduces the feature film's two main protagonists: Dr. Elias Shaw (played here by Zach Lona)—the immortal & eccentric director of Site-19—and SCP-181 (Charlie Bain)—a D-Class with anomalous luck—as they each attempt to survive mounting threats, bureaucratic nausea, a hostile conspiracy, and horrifying paranormal phenomena that weaponize human attention.
